change.after: "policy exceptions disabled by default; allowed only in a specified namespace"

consequence.statement: The defaults now disable policy exceptions and only allow them in a specified namespace; backward compatibility requires following the upgrade guidance.
consequence.remediation: Follow the upgrade guidance to keep the previous behavior if exceptions are needed in other namespaces.

assertion.statement: Policy exceptions, previously allowed in all namespaces, are now disabled by default and can only be created in a specified namespace (CVE-2024-48921 hardening).
